components.name: proposition
values: combining pertweight and pertlocal encoders yields synergistic improvement over using either alone.

components.name: proposition
values: attentionpert s superior performance is not solely due to discarding cross-gene layer reducing perturbed genes or using gene2vec the architecture design is essential.

components.name: proposition
values: attentionpert integrates global and local perturbation effects via pertweight and pertlocal encoders improving prediction of nuanced transcriptional responses to single and multi-gene perturbations.

components.name: proposition
values: attentionpert captures nonadditive effects of multi-gene perturbations outperforming the additive baseline.

components.name: proposition
values: na-bias module in pertlocal enhances prediction of nonadditive expression changes.

components.name: proposition
values: attentionpert outperforms prior methods including sota gears on rpe1 k562 and norman datasets.

components.name: proposition
values: attentionpert achieves superior performance in predicting out-of-distribution multi-gene perturbations where none of the perturbed genes are seen during training.

components.name: method
values: attentionpert | attentionpert takes perturbation indicators as input into two modules pertweight and pertlocal encoders. each outputs an encoding matrix rk d . the sum is fed into a gene-specific linear decoder to predict the expression shift. the prediction is added to a random control sample. loss function combines auto-focus and direction-aware loss gears . hyperparameters embedding size de=200 gene2vec sgconv hops t=1 hidden size d=64 attention heads h=2 head dimension dq=dk=dv=64 go graph edge weight multiplier α=0.75 na-bias β=0.05 trained for 20 epochs batch size 128 adam optimizer with learning rate 1e-3.

gene ontology graph construction | go graph j built with edge weights equal to fraction of shared gene ontology terms between two genes following gears roohani et al. 2023 . augmented go graph includes additional na-bias edges with weight β.

gene-specific linear decoder | takes sum of hpw and hpl for each gene k a linear layer maps the encoding to scalar perturbation effect per-gene weights wk and bias bk . abandons cross-gene layer used in gears.
pertlocal encoder | applies sgconv on augmented go graph to produce b. masks b by perturbation indicators. optionally includes na-bias module to predict nonadditive effects. outputs hpl.

pertweight encoder | embeds genes into weight embedding ew and pert embedding ep. applies four sgconv gnn encoders on the go graph to produce q k v p. v is masked by perturbation indicators. multi-head attention computes weighted global effects combined with p via addition and feed-forward layers to produce hpw.
pre-trained gene2vec initialization | all gene embeddings ew ep eb initialized with 200d gene2vec vectors derived from co-expression across 984 geo datasets can be fine-tuned during training.

components.name: task
values: predict post-perturbation gene expressions given specific gene-perturbation conditions by minimizing the difference between predicted and ground-truth mean expression shifts.
